wins.proof:
constructor
  intro h
  have h1 := h 0 0
  have h2 := h 1 0
  have h3 := h 0 1
  have h4 := h 1 1
  simp at h1 h2 h3 h4
  intro z
  by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all
  <;>
  (try
    { use 0
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  (try
    { use 2 * z + f 0
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  (try
    { use f 0
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  (try
    { use 2 * z + f 0 + f 1
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  aesop

constructor
  intro h
  have h1 := h 0 0
  have h2 := h 1 0
  have h3 := h 0 1
  have h4 := h 1 1
  simp at h1 h2 h3 h4
  intro z
  by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all
  <;>
  (try
    { use 0
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  (try
    { use 2 * z + f 0
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  (try
    { use f 0
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  (try
    { use 2 * z + f 0 + f 1
      intro z
      by_cases hz : f z = 0 <;> simp_all })
  <;>
  all_goals (first | (norm_num at * <;> grind; done) | grind | bound | (nlinarith [sq_nonneg (0:ℝ)]) | (intros; norm_num [*]; done) | omega | decide | (field_simp; ring) | linarith | positivity | (simp_all; done) | aesop)
